# The Global Bond Rout

Report 198 | Published 2026-09-27 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2026-9-27/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/198.json)

Higher yields, fiscal transmission and energy income.

The rate decision and energy windfalls are verified. The central unresolved step is the leap from large public borrowing to an approximately stimulative net effect of rate hikes. EPD’s stated distribution-growth rate is overstated; its long-term income thesis and Bitcoin outlook remain open.

**Coverage:** Full numbered text and image inventory read. All material theses across macro, digital assets, investment analysis and concluding sections considered. Position listings and incidental descriptive statistics are excluded unless they support a thesis.

### 198-C05

**Rate hikes are approximately net stimulative now.**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Evidence needed |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | rate-hikes-net-stimulative |
| Source blocks | 44, 52, 54, 56, 57, 58, 59 |

Comparing total government issuance with private lending does not establish the marginal response to a rate change. Repricing maturities, recipient spending propensities, credit demand, asset values, exchange rates and expectations all matter. The claimed net offset requires an estimated counterfactual, not an accounting comparison of flow sizes.

**Direction:** See assessment; evidence is limited to the stated proposition.

For unchanged cash balances earning a floating rate and unchanged fixed-rate debt payments, a rate increase raises nominal net interest income. This validates the personal example but cannot be generalized to the whole economy without measuring other households and firms.

**Direction:** See assessment; evidence is limited to the stated proposition.

**Timing:** No fixed deadline stated.

**Mechanism:** Price direction alone does not identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Deductive assessment:**

- Cash yield reprices upward
- Debt payment is fixed
- Balances unchanged

Net interest-income change equals cash balance times yield increase, while debt interest is unchanged.

As an accounting identity, issuance not bought abroad must be held domestically. ## Framework lessons

- An accounting income channel is not a complete macroeconomic causal estimate.
- Temporary profits can improve a balance sheet without guaranteeing permanence.

## Verification limitations

- Current page snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- A missing horizon is not replaced with an invented author deadline.
- Market sensitivities use vendor adjusted closes and do not reconstruct portfolio execution.
